svg.title: Modeled diabetes prevalence by Massachusetts census tract
svg.desc: A source-labeled teaching map of all 1,620 Massachusetts census tracts. The map displays 1,597 CDC PLACES modeled crude diabetes prevalence estimates in five absolute classes, retains 23 tracts as unavailable, and hatches 49 tracts for classroom support review. The map does not rank, target, or assign eligibility to any tract. A complete exact table and text alternative accompany it.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start

g.text: Modeled diabetes prevalence by Massachusetts census tract
Measure year 2023, CDC PLACES 2025 tract release. Absolute classes, not ranks. Gray means unavailable. Hatching marks a classroom review trigger, not a CDC quality label.
Public modeled estimates are not observed cases, individual risk, a disparity finding, or an action rule. See the complete exact table and text alternative.
